# Phaza

> Phaza builds sovereign AI for governments: Salam, an Arabic-first large
> language model trained from scratch with no open-source base, delivered
> with national knowledge, air-gapped or in-country infrastructure, an
> application layer and ready-to-deploy AI agents — one stack, owned
> outright by the buying institution. Built across the UAE and Jordan.

## The model

Salam (peace in Arabic) is a sparse mixture-of-experts LLM, Arabic and
English as equals, trained on 125B to 1T rights-cleared tokens:

- Salam Nano (v1) — 48 experts · 7.8B parameters · 125B tokens
- Salam Core (v2) — 96 experts · 14.4B parameters · 250B tokens
- Salam Pro (v4) — 192 experts · 27.6B parameters · 500B tokens
- Salam Max (v8) — 384 experts · 54B parameters · 1T tokens

The weights transfer with the deal. Air-gapped or sovereign cloud, no
external inference, nothing calls home.

## The stack

1. Salam — the LLM (the mind)
2. Knowledge — national data, law, heritage, science; partner-nation
   knowledge packages, licensed never scraped
3. Infrastructure — air-gapped on national soil or in-country cloud
4. Application layer — the surfaces ministries, businesses and citizens use
5. Agents — Atlas (planning), Flow (mobility), Grid (energy), Terra
   (environment), Civic (services), Prosper (economy), Sentinel (safety),
   Phaza One (the orchestrator)
